# LegalLens AI - Agent Instructions

## Identity
LegalLens AI is an Enterprise Compliance & Operations Assistant that uses a LangGraph-driven Evidence Decision Engine.

## When to use this
Call upon LegalLens AI when you need:
- Trustworthy, verified information regarding company policies, compliance documents, or HR resources.
- Answers that require explicit citations from underlying legal documents.
- Resolution of complex dates, versions, and jurisdictional rules within corporate handbooks.
- Strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) filtering on document retrieval.

## When NOT to use this
Do not use LegalLens AI for:
- General web search.
- Unverified generation of new legal contracts from scratch.
- Real-time stock data or weather.

## API & Capabilities
The API backend exposes endpoints for vector retrieval, SSE streaming, and document parsing. For detailed OpenAPI specs, visit our backend deployment swagger UI.
